correctness.rationale: The finding fixes the LCF graph [12,7,-7]^8, ordinary closed-neighborhood identification, and moves preserving size-optimality. If k vertices identify, 4k is the total signature size and at most k of the 24 nonempty distinct signatures are singletons, so 5k >= 48. An independent direct-signature search checked all 1,961,256 ten-sets and 2,496,144 eleven-sets, giving 0 and 384 codes, respectively. It checked all 54,912 oriented one-for-one replacements. There are 208 jump components and 272 jump edges: 176 singletons, 16 isolated edges and 16 copies of the specified glued-clique graph T. For each T it checked both four-cliques, their common vertex, and the four distinct noncentral attachments, two on each clique. It expressly checked that the two slides in each T are pendant and that no jump K2 supplies a slide. There are 352 slide components and 32 slide edges, giving 320 slide-frozen codes. Diameter 4 follows from two leaves on opposite cliques. The frozen Python lines 125–126 check T and the number of slides per jump component, but not their placement on pendant edges; the new replay checks the missing assertion. This is exact on this graph only, not for larger budgets, other cages or stronger identification predicates.
residual_risks: The frozen reproducibility notes overstate the pendant-slide check in the packaged verification; the independent replay verifies it directly.

value.rationale: Optimum-preserving detector relocation is a natural question on this canonical cage, and the exact fragmentation could be useful as a benchmark. But the significant prior input is not merely the host graph or the number 384: it specifies every labelled optimum by a short orbit table. Expanding those orbits and doing at most 73,536 pairwise symmetric-difference tests, one base-graph edge lookup per jump, and ordinary component/degree traversal mechanically gives the whole reported invariant, including the glued-clique shape and pendant slides. No further mathematical property explaining or separating these exchanges is established beyond inspecting that fixed computed graph. The record independently reproduces a correct, previously unstated table-derived fact, but does not meet the nonmechanical requirement for a contribution this narrow. Better motivation or a corrected checker assertion would not change this limitation.
residual_risks: This judgment does not deny utility as benchmark data or imply the reported components were previously printed.
